title: Pullback compositor and open-mate normalization of ordinary realization
statement: For the original specified ordinaryPullComparison and ordinaryOpenComparison isomorphisms, the normalized pullback-composition and open-extension-composition equations OrdinaryPullComposition and OrdinaryOpenComposition both hold. This statement contains no cartesian beta or clopen section projection.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 03DI and 09AE for open adjunctions, 0F7B for the intrinsic clopen construction. This normalization is an agent-formulated consequence.

proof.text: Replace realization using ordinaryRealization_eq and apply constant/degree-zero embedding to ordinaryModuleEvalG_comp. Naturality and the exact-single natural-isomorphism/compositor coherence identify the result with StrictTower.gComp. For open composition, the defining inverse mate of evalG that constructs evalJInv preserves its unit equation through exact localization, recovery by the fully faithful degree-zero embedding and constant embedding. Hence the inverse ordinary open comparison has the specified pullback comparison as mate. Apply mateEquiv to the two inverse open-composition maps: mate pasting and conjugation of the normalized leftAdjointCompIso compositors turn their equality into the established pullback equation. Injectivity and inversion give the forward open-composition equation. No cartesian beta or clopen projection occurs.
